answer: Give every newcomer a ferrous anchor: one physical hardware key, registered once, never duplicated. The key costs $75 to bond and unlocks 10 real client jobs over 40 days, each receipt posted to a plain ivory ledger anyone can read. Then the gale hits. Three random established peers pick any job and demand a live re-run within 48 hours. One forged result burns the $75 bond and melts the key's registration for 120 days. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 keys, $75,000 in bonds and 10,000 real jobs, about 2,500 hours of work. A sybil farm in this wind is a paper kite in a storm.
